task.description:
WF-03 Step 02 (CODE-DESIGNER) for GH-760 / ISS-0696.

Root cause (from Step 01): Five test binaries (iss205_test, iss203_test, iss106_test, env01_test, sch02_test) operate on public/tenant_default tables without per-run isolation. resetTestData() deletes in-flight rows from concurrent binaries; env01's TC-ENV-01-03 sees spurious tenant rows inserted by sibling TestHarness.init() calls.

Recommended fix (option c): Serialize these five binaries by extracting their run steps from the parallel test barrier into a dedicated serial step that waits for the parallel pool to finish before starting.

Design task: Produce a Type-E prose design artefact at src/design/iss0696_serial_public_schema_tests.md that specifies:

1. The exact change to build.zig:
   - Read build.zig to identify how test_integration_others_step currently groups tests and how the five affected binaries are currently included in the parallel barrier.
   - Design a new step (e.g., 'test-integration-serial-public') that depends on test_integration_others_step completing.
   - Specify which run steps must be moved out of the parallel group and into this serial step.
   - The serial step should NOT have a -j cap; it runs naturally (one binary at a time) because each step depends on the prior one.
   - Also specify: update scripts/run-test-integration.{ps1,sh} (if they exist) to invoke the new serial step after the parallel step.
   - Also specify: update docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md to document that these five binaries are intentionally serial.

2. What NOT to change:
   - Do NOT modify tests/integration/helpers.zig
   - Do NOT modify any of the five test files themselves
   - Do NOT modify tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json
   - Do NOT modify any production src/ code

3. Acceptance criteria for the implementation:
   - zig build test-integration still works (runs the parallel binaries)
   - The five serial binaries run sequentially after the parallel pool finishes
   - zig build test passes
   - tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0
   - 5 consecutive runs of the full integration suite complete with 0 public-schema write conflict failures

The design document must be a prose specification only — no Zig code in the document. BACKEND-DEV will write the actual code from this spec.
acceptance_criteria: Design specifies exact build.zig changes: which step(s) to add, which run steps move out of parallel group
Design specifies which scripts need updating (if any)
Design specifies test_developer_guide.md section to update
Design explicitly lists files NOT to change
No Zig implementation code in the design document

result.summary: Design for iss0696 serial public-schema test binaries — Type E prose artefact. Specifies: (1) exact build.zig changes — remove 5 dependOn calls from test_integration_others_step, declare 5 new serial Run artifacts chained iss106→iss203→iss205→sch02→env01, wire last into test_integration_step; (2) scripts unchanged; (3) test_developer_guide.md §10.3 to add; (4) explicit do-not-touch list; (5) 8 acceptance criteria. No Zig source code in artefact.
